title: TokenectomyBotConfig
description: Configuration schema for Tokenectomy PR Verification Gate (tokenectomy.json)

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for editor validation and autocompletion

extends.description: Base preset rule configuration: 'recommended' (balanced), 'strict' (all rules error), or 'agent-pr' (anti-tampering always error)

fail_on.description: Threshold severity that triggers non-zero exit code gate failure

anyOf.description: Rule state shortcut: 'off' to disable, or severity name to enable

ignore.description: Glob patterns for file paths to completely exclude from scanning

logger_names.description: Custom identifiers or member expressions recognized as loggers for rule TB101 (silent-catch)

orm_modules.description: Custom ORM import module names recognized for rule TB102 (unbounded-query)

overrides.description: Path-specific rule overrides (e.g. relaxing checks in test or legacy files)

files.description: Glob patterns matching target files for this override block

rules.description: Rule overrides applied to files matching this block

custom_rules_dir.description: Path to directory containing custom Tree-sitter SCM (.scm) verification rules

org_policy.description: Path, JSON string, or preset name for organization-wide policy enforcement
